title.description: Title of the settings page, at the top of its side navigation.

navLabel.description: Accessible name of the settings page's side navigation.

close.description: Accessible name of the button that closes the settings page and returns to the editor.

closeHint.description: Key cap under the close button: the Escape key. Keep it short and lowercase.

search.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the field that filters settings by name, description and key.

noResults.description: Shown when the settings search finds nothing. {{query}} is what the user typed.

openFile.description: Button that opens the settings file in the default editor. settings.json is a file name; keep it as is.

import.description: Button that imports settings from a JSON file.

export.description: Button that exports the settings to a JSON file.

modified.description: Accessible name of the dot next to a setting that differs from its default.

reset.description: Button next to a changed setting that puts it back to its default.

changeFailed.description: Toast title when a setting change is rejected. The reason is shown below it.

actionFailed.description: Toast title when a settings action (import, export, open a file or folder, a theme action) fails. The reason is shown below it.

section.general.description: Settings section: appearance, theme, language and app behavior.

section.editor.description: Settings section for the code editor.

section.execution.description: Settings section for how fiddles run.

section.electron.description: Settings section for Electron versions and downloads.

section.github.description: Settings section for the GitHub account and gists. GitHub is a product name.

section.keybindings.description: Settings section that lists every command and its shortcut.

section.about.description: Settings section with the app version and its contributors.

appearance.title.description: Setting: light, dark, or follow the system.

appearance.description.message: Follow the system, or always use light or dark.

appearance.system.description: Appearance option: follow the operating system's light or dark mode.

appearance.fromTheme.message: {{theme}} sets its own light or dark mode.
appearance.fromTheme.description: Shown under the appearance setting while a custom theme is active. {{theme}} is the theme's name.

theme.description.message: Lucent is built in. Custom themes are JSON files in your themes folder.
theme.description.description: Help for the theme setting. Lucent is the built-in theme's name; keep it as is. JSON is a file format.

theme.lucent.description: Name of the built-in theme. Keep it as is.

theme.highContrastDark.description: Name of the built-in high-contrast dark theme. Lucent is the design system's name; keep it as is.

theme.highContrastLight.description: Name of the built-in high-contrast light theme. Lucent is the design system's name; keep it as is.

theme.dark.description: Hint next to a custom theme that is dark.

theme.light.description: Hint next to a custom theme that is light.

theme.importMonaco.description: Button that imports a Monaco editor theme file. Monaco is a product name.

theme.create.description: Button that writes a new theme file based on the current theme.

theme.openFolder.description: Button that opens the folder with custom theme files.

locale.description.message: Menus and the app switch right away. The editor switches after a restart.

locale.system.description: Language option: use the operating system's language.

locale.relaunchTitle.message: Relaunch to finish switching the language
locale.relaunchTitle.description: Toast title after the language setting changes.

locale.relaunchDescription.message: Menus and the app use it already. The editor and system texts switch after a relaunch.
locale.relaunchDescription.description: Toast text after the language setting changes. System texts are the ones Chromium draws, like context menus and form controls.

locale.relaunch.description: Toast action that restarts the app.

sessionRestore.title.description: Setting: reopen the last session's windows.

sessionRestore.description.message: Reopen every window from the last session, with its fiddle, version and layout.
sessionRestore.description.description: Help for the session restore setting.

notifications.description.message: Notify me when a long operation finishes while Electron Fiddle is in the background.

editorFontFamily.description.message: A list of font names, such as Fira Code, monospace. Leave it empty to use Commit Mono.
editorFontFamily.description.description: Help for the editor font setting. Fira Code and Commit Mono are font names; keep them as is.

editorFontFamily.invalid.message: Use font names separated by commas.
editorFontFamily.invalid.description: Error under the editor font field when the value isn't a font list.

editorFontSize.description.message: In pixels, from 8 to 40. Leave it empty for the default.
editorFontSize.description.description: Help for the editor font size setting.

editorFontSize.invalid.message: Enter a whole number from 8 to 40.
editorFontSize.invalid.description: Error under the font size field.

editorFont.reloadHint.message: Font changes apply after the windows reload.
editorFont.reloadHint.description: Note under the editor font settings, next to a button that reloads every window.

editorFont.reload.description: Button next to the editor font settings that reloads every window so a new font applies. Unsaved text is kept.

electronFlags.title.description: Setting: extra command-line flags for Electron.

electronFlags.description.message: Passed to Electron when a fiddle runs.
electronFlags.description.description: Help for the Electron flags list.

electronFlags.invalid.message: A flag can have at most 1,000 characters.
electronFlags.invalid.description: Error under an Electron flag row that is too long.

environmentVariables.title.description: Setting: environment variables for every run.

environmentVariables.description.message: Set for every run, one KEY=value per row.
environmentVariables.description.description: Help for the environment variables list. Keep KEY=value as is.

environmentVariables.invalid.message: Use KEY=value. The key needs letters, digits or underscores.
environmentVariables.invalid.description: Error under an environment variable row. Keep KEY=value as is.

list.add.description: Button that adds an empty row to a list setting.

list.remove.description: Accessible name of the button that removes a row from a list setting.

packageManager.description.description: Help for the package manager setting. npm is a product name.

socketFirewall.title.description: Setting: check packages with Socket Firewall. Socket Firewall is a product name.

socketFirewall.description.message: Checks packages for malware before they're installed.
socketFirewall.description.description: Help for the Socket Firewall setting.

keepUserDataDirs.title.description: Setting: keep each run's user data folder.

keepUserDataDirs.description.message: Don't delete a fiddle's user data folder after it runs.
keepUserDataDirs.description.description: Help for the keep user data folders setting.

electronLogging.description.description: Help for the advanced logging setting.

clearConsoleOnRun.title.message: Clear the console on every run
clearConsoleOnRun.title.description: Setting: empty the console when a run starts.

clearConsoleOnRun.description.message: Start each run with an empty console.
clearConsoleOnRun.description.description: Help for the clear console setting.

channels.title.description: Setting: which Electron release channels the version picker shows.

channels.description.message: The version picker shows these channels. The current version's channel stays on.
channels.description.description: Help for the release channels setting.

showNotDownloaded.title.description: Setting: list every release in the version picker.

showNotDownloaded.description.message: List every release, not only the ones on this computer.
showNotDownloaded.description.description: Help for the show not-downloaded versions setting.

showObsolete.description.message: Include major versions that are no longer supported.
showObsolete.description.description: Help for the show obsolete versions setting.

mirror.title.description: Setting: where Electron downloads come from.

mirror.description.message: Use a mirror if you can't reach GitHub releases.
mirror.description.description: Help for the mirror setting. GitHub is a product name.

mirror.auto.description: Mirror option: pick by the system's language and region.

mirror.default.description: Mirror option: Electron's GitHub releases. Product name.

mirror.china.description: Mirror option: the npmmirror.com mirror in China. Keep npmmirror as is.

mirror.custom.description: Mirror option: the user's own mirror URLs.

customMirrorElectron.title.description: Setting: the custom mirror for Electron releases.

customMirrorElectron.description.message: Used for stable and beta releases.
customMirrorElectron.description.description: Help for the custom Electron mirror URL.

customMirrorNightly.title.description: Setting: the custom mirror for nightly releases.

customMirrorNightly.description.description: Help for the custom nightly mirror URL.

mirror.invalidUrl.description: Error under a mirror URL field.

packageAuthor.title.description: Setting: the author written to package.json. package.json is a file name; keep it as is.

packageAuthor.description.message: Used when a fiddle is saved or packaged. Leave it empty to use your user name.
packageAuthor.description.description: Help for the package.json author setting.

packageAuthor.invalid.message: The author can have at most 200 characters.
packageAuthor.invalid.description: Error under the package.json author field when the value is too long. package.json is a file name; keep it as is.

gistShowHistory.description.message: Show a gist's revisions when you open it.
gistShowHistory.description.description: Help for the gist history setting.

gistPublishAsRevision.title.description: Setting: publish a new gist in two steps, so its history shows the fiddle's files as a change.

gistPublishAsRevision.description.message: Creates the gist from the default template first, then updates it with your files, so the gist's history shows your changes.
gistPublishAsRevision.description.description: Help for the publish as revision setting.

gistVisibility.title.description: Setting: whether new gists are secret or public.

gistVisibility.description.message: Secret gists are only visible to people with the link.
gistVisibility.description.description: Help for the gist visibility setting.

keybindings.description.message: Change, remove or reset the shortcut for any command.
keybindings.description.description: Help for the keyboard shortcuts section.

keybindings.none.description: Shown instead of a shortcut when a command has none.

keybindings.change.description: Button that records a new shortcut for a command.

keybindings.record.description: Shown while recording a shortcut. Escape cancels.

keybindings.recordLabel.message: New shortcut for {{command}}. Press Escape to cancel.
keybindings.recordLabel.description: Accessible name of the recording field. {{command}} is the command's name.

keybindings.remove.description: Accessible name of the button that unbinds a command's shortcut.

keybindings.resetLabel.description: Accessible name of the reset button in a shortcut row. {{command}} is the command's name.

keybindings.conflict.description: Warning when a shortcut is shared. {{commands}} lists the other commands' names.

keybindings.filter.description: Placeholder of the field that filters the shortcut list.

screenReader.title.description: Setting: optimize the editor for screen readers.

screenReader.description.message: Makes the editor work well with a screen reader. Automatic follows your system.
screenReader.description.description: Help for the screen reader setting.

screenReader.auto.description: Screen reader option: follow the system.

screenReader.active.message: The editor is in screen reader mode.
screenReader.active.description: Status under the screen reader setting.

screenReader.inactive.message: The editor is in standard mode.
screenReader.inactive.description: Status under the screen reader setting.

crashReports.description.message: Helps fix bugs. The contents of your fiddles, console output and environment variables are never sent.
crashReports.description.description: Help for the crash reports setting.

about.version.description: The app's version in the about section. {{version}} is a version number.

about.electron.description: The Electron version the app runs on. {{version}} is a version number.

about.notices.description: Toggle in the about section that shows the license notices of third-party software and fonts the app includes.

notice.corrupt.title.description: Toast title when a data file couldn't be read. {{file}} is the file name.

notice.corrupt.description.message: Electron Fiddle set it aside and is using a backup or the defaults.
notice.corrupt.description.description: Toast text when a data file couldn't be read.

notice.newer.title.description: Toast title when a data file was written by a newer version of the app. {{file}} is the file name.

notice.newer.description.message: Changes won't be saved to it until you update Electron Fiddle.
notice.newer.description.description: Toast text when a data file is from a newer app version.

notice.dismiss.description: Toast action that dismisses a data file notice.

privacyReset.title.description: Title of the macOS action that resets the privacy permissions (camera, microphone and so on) given to the app.

privacyReset.description.message: Fiddles run as the standard Electron app, so the camera, microphone and other permissions you give a fiddle belong to it, and macOS asks again for each Electron version. This forgets them all, for Electron Fiddle too.
privacyReset.description.description: Help for the reset privacy permissions action.

privacyReset.button.description: Button that resets the privacy permissions, after a confirmation.

privacyReset.done.description: Toast after the privacy permissions were reset.
